caption: MCP Jsonrpc Message
description: Refers to any valid JSON-RPC object that can be decoded off the wire, or encoded to be sent. Generated from the pinned MCP schema (2025-11-25 JSONRPCMessage; 2026-07-28 JSONRPCMessage).
name: mcp_jsonrpc_message

mcp_jsonrpc_request.description: The value when it is the alternative JSONRPCRequest.

mcp_jsonrpc_notification.description: The value when it is the alternative JSONRPCNotification.

mcp_jsonrpc_result_response.description: The value when it is the alternative JSONRPCResultResponse.

mcp_jsonrpc_error_response.description: The value when it is the alternative JSONRPCErrorResponse.

mcp_unresolved.description: The value exactly as reported when no single alternative matches it by its constant and required members.
